description: This file provides centralized helper functions for activity logging within a Django project, including functions for logging general activities and model-specific events, with considerations for multi-tenant architecture and non-blocking behavior.

methods.name: str|None _get_client_ip(request)
methods.description: Extracts the client's IP address from a request object, trying headers like 'HTTP_X_FORWARDED_FOR' and 'REMOTE_ADDR'.

methods.name: str _safe_obj_repr(instance: Any)
methods.description: Generates a stable and short string representation of an object, defaulting to class name on exceptions.

methods.name: Any _resolve_org(request, instance)
methods.description: Resolves the organization/tenant context from the request or an instance, respecting multi-tenant patterns.

methods.name: None log_activity( *, user: Any | None, action: str, module: str, record_id: str = "", status: str = ActivityLog.Status.SUCCESS, object_type: str = "", object_id: str = "", object_repr: str = "", metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None, org: Any | None = None, request: Any | None = None, )
methods.description: Creates an activity log entry for general actions, designed to be non-blocking and tenant-safe.

methods.name: None log_model_event( *, instance: Any, action: str, module: str, status: str = ActivityLog.Status.SUCCESS, request: Any | None = None, )
methods.description: Logs CRUD events for models, wrapping activity logging for create/update/delete actions.

ctags.signature: ( *, instance: Any, action: str, module: str, status: str = ActivityLog.Status.SUCCESS, request: Any | None = None, )
